value.signature: fn audit (& self , budget : AuditBudget , usage : & mut AuditUsage) -> Result < AuditInventory , AuditFailure >

review.body: { let operation = cli_common :: observation :: scope ("HOST" , "sig:design:storage" , "storage::tree::MemoryTree < 'a >::audit" , & (budget ,) ,) ; * usage = AuditUsage :: default () ; let mut meter = audit :: AuditMeter :: new (budget) ; let result = meter . begin (budget) . and_then (| () | audit :: reconcile (self , & mut meter)) ; * usage = meter . usage () ; operation . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: The public memory audit observes an immutable tree under caller-supplied bounded work and logical retention allowances. It returns an owned logical inventory or one located refusal. The operation carries no credentials or session state.
